heading: The Process
intro: A clear, accessible and confidential pathway from initial contact to beginning therapy.

steps.title: Initial Enquiry
steps.description: Submit the contact form or send an email. All enquiries are treated with full discretion and responded to in a timely manner.

steps.title: Complimentary Consultation
steps.description: An initial consultation is a free 20-minute call for you to discuss your needs, ask me any questions, and establish whether I am the right clinician for you and your situation.

steps.title: Begin Treatment
steps.description: Sessions are scheduled at a suitable time for you. We will work together to identify your goals in therapy, set sustainable targets and review progress regularly.
